title: exists strictPerfect lower model
statement:
Let E have universal Tor amplitude in [a,b], a≤b, and let P represent E on U by a bounded strict-perfect complex with terms above b zero. There is a covering sieve of U on each arrow V→U of which E has a bounded strict-perfect representative whose terms outside [a,b] vanish. Sheafification, derived-category and universe assumptions are precisely those displayed below.

Precise quantified statement:
theorem exists_strictPerfect_lower_model
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [∀ U : C, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    [∀ U : C, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R))]
    [hDU : ∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R).over U))]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)))
    (U : C)
    (P : StrictPerfectCoefficientRepresentationOfUniverses.{u, v, 0} R U
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R) U E))
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hupper : ∀ r : ℤ, b < r → IsZero (P.F.X r))
    (hTor : ∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R))
        (r : ℤ), r < a ∨ b < r →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ r).obj
        ((wfSiteDerivedTensor J R).obj
          (E, (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G)))) :
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ J U ∧
      ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
        ∃ P : StrictPerfectCoefficientRepresentationOfUniverses.{u, v, 0} R V
          (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R) V E),
          ∀ r : ℤ, r < a ∨ b < r → IsZero (P.F.X r)

proof.text: Restrict a bounded flat model of E exactly to show that the chart has no cohomology below a. Locally the opcycles in degree a are a finite free retract by the boundary lemma. Apply the good lower truncation after restriction. Its degree-a term is the opcycle, higher terms retain the finite-free splittings and lower terms vanish. The canonical map is a quasi-isomorphism by the cohomology bound. The inequality a<=b retains the upper term bound. Derived restriction and composition comparisons identify the resulting representative with E on the new slice.
